program='''def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    vertical_rows = list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1))
    return [list(grid[r][::-1]) + list(grid[r]) for r in vertical_rows]
'''
pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
